calls.title: Discuss AI features for Customer Feedback
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies for gathering customer insights to inform AI product development and roadmap priorities. Emphasis was placed on understanding customer workflows and pain points rather than just feature pitching. Specific plans included preparing targeted questions for customer meetings, exploring AI feature desires, and improving integration with existing tools. Additionally, the roadmap for AI features highlighted the development of a persistent AI copilot and expansion of the MCP server API. The team also identified opportunities to improve experiment management and analytics integration, such as session replay features and stale feature flag detection workflows. Strategic positioning involves integrating with existing tools like Brain Trust to enhance observability and product differentiation through unique access to production data.
calls.keywords: MCP Server, AI Roadmap, LLM Testing, AI Data Analyst, Experimentation Workflow, Product Analytics
